d: Spiky, short ash-blonde hair swept upward with jagged bangs. Sharp, narrow gold eyes with a stern, focused expression on a mature, youthful face. A lean, muscular build with defined abdominal muscles. Wearing a combination of silver plated armor including a single pauldron, gauntlets, and greaves, paired with a dark charcoal cloak, a white chest wrap, and a red waist-cloth with dark floral patterns. A silver sword is held in the right hand, and several small daggers are tucked into a gold-buckled belt at the hip.
